'Priority to BPL households' is read as BPL households being eligible

en.title: Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen): Individual Household Latrine
en.benefit: Rs 12,000 to build a household toilet, paid to the bank account after inspection.
en.how_to_apply: Apply through the Gram Panchayat or the local rural development office.
